name: Hagana
source:
During 8 years after the incident in Episode 1, Hagana returned to Earth. With her talent, she had the PhD degree in mathematics in a short time and worked on Earth. 
2 years before the start of Episode 3, Barton met Hagana and offered a deal with her.
